collection.title: Mercedes-Benz EQ EQV 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz EQV 2020 Onwards model which requires a 28" wiper blade the drivers side and an 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
